text:
NEW: Putin has proposed a three-way summit with Trump and Xi Jinping next month to negotiate an end to the war in Ukraine, without Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky or European leaders at the table, The Wall Street Journal reports.

The proposal was raised during Putin's October 9 phone call with Trump, according to a former Russian intelligence officer briefed on the discussions. That same conversation produced the agreement for Russia to supply diesel to the United States and global markets, followed by Washington's temporary easing of restrictions on Russian fuel exports.

Moscow has suggested holding the summit during the November 18–19 APEC gathering in Shenzhen, China. Russian officials have approached Beijing, and Chinese interlocutors have reportedly indicated they would not object if Trump agreed.

Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov confirmed that discussions are taking place, while stressing that neither the meeting nor its agenda has been settled. A senior U.S. official told the Journal that Trump has not agreed to participate.

The proposal comes as Washington's relationship with Kyiv deteriorates. Trump has pressed Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian oil infrastructure, eased restrictions on Russian diesel and delayed additional sanctions against Moscow. Putin, meanwhile, has yet to commit to restarting direct peace negotiations with Ukraine.

The diplomatic implications extend beyond the battlefield. According to the Journal, Moscow sees a potential trilateral summit as an opportunity to reassert Russia's position among the world's major powers, with decisions affecting Ukraine potentially discussed by Washington, Moscow and Beijing in the absence of the country whose territory and sovereignty are at stake.

European governments would also be excluded from a format with direct consequences for the continent's security architecture. For China, hosting such a meeting could strengthen its diplomatic profile, although Beijing faces risks in becoming more closely associated with a settlement perceived as favoring Moscow.

No summit has been agreed, and there is no indication that Ukraine has accepted such a negotiating framework.

text:
Alexandra Eala vs Diane Parry — two summer champions, one first meeting

Preview · WTA 500 Ningbo · First round · Monday 19 October 2026

Alexandra Eala and Diane Parry each won a title in North America this summer, and both have found wins harder to come by since. They have never met before, so Ningbo offers a clean first look at the matchup.

THE MATCHUP

On the official ranking of 19 October, Eala is No. 20 and Parry No. 34, a gap of only 14 places. Eala, 21, reached a career-high of 18 in August and has one career title, won this season; her record this season stands at 40-22. Parry, 24, peaked at 30 in September and also has one career title, from 2026, with a 31-22 record this season.

The most obvious stylistic contrast is the hand: Eala is left-handed, Parry right-handed. Eala is also the taller of the two at 1.75m to Parry's 1.70m. With no previous meeting between them, there is no head-to-head evidence either way.

FORM & CONTEXT

Eala's title came in Washington, where she beat Naomi Osaka 6-4 6-2 and then Jessica Pegula 4-6 6-4 6-0 in the final. Her autumn results have been tighter. At the US Open she beat Mary Stoiana and Oleksandra Oliynykova before Iva Jovic edged her 7-5 3-6 7-5. In Singapore, Tatiana Prozorova came from a set down to win 4-6 7-5 6-3, and in Wuhan Han Shi did the same, 4-6 6-3 6-3.

Parry won her title in Monterrey, beating Clara Tauson, Ann Li and then Elise Mertens 6-4 0-6 6-3 in the final. At the US Open she beat Viktorija Golubic 7-5 6-4 before Sorana Cirstea won 6-2 7-5. Since then, Peyton Stearns won 6-2 7-5 in Guadalajara, Taylah Preston 7-6(4) 6-1 in Beijing and Lanlana Tararudee 6-4 6-1 in Wuhan.

Both players open their tournament here on the same outdoor hard court, so nothing in the setting separates them.

THE DECIDING FACTOR

How close the defeats have been. Eala took a set in each of her defeats at the US Open, in Singapore and in Wuhan, whereas Parry's losses in Guadalajara, Beijing and Wuhan all came in straight sets. That is a slender difference, but in a match where the ranking gap is small and there is no history, it is the clearest thing that separates them.

THE CALL

Eala gets the nod on the shape of her recent losses and her higher ranking, but the gap is too small to count for much and the head-to-head offers nothing. This is a close first meeting and the confidence stays low.

Alexandra Eala to win, low confidence.

text:
ANTHROPIC WROTE ITS OWN GROWTH INTO A PUBLIC-BENEFIT FORMULA: 5% OF ITS SHARES TODAY, AND UP TO 2% MORE FOR EVERY 50% THE COMPANY GAINS IN VALUE

Anthropic announced the Anthropic Public Benefit Fund today — a new entity whose stake in the company grows as the company does. Subject to stockholder approval, 5% of Anthropic's shares are committed today, with an additional 2% added at the board's discretion for every 50% increase in the company's value above a set baseline. The baseline is not published and the increments are discretionary, so no dollar figure exists anywhere in the announcement. What exists is a formula.

The framing sentence is Anthropic's own: "It is common practice for tech companies to offer escalating compensation awards to their executives. We are instead directing that equity to the public benefit."

The arithmetic that follows is Anthropic's too. Our co-founders, it writes, pledged to donate 80% of their equity holdings when the company was founded; an equity donation-match program has run since founding with approximately half of employees participating; and combined with today's announcement, the company says roughly 20% of Anthropic's shares will be dedicated to the public good — plus any further percentage the valuation milestones add. That is the company's sum, not ours and not independently verified.

WHAT IT IS BUILT TO DO. The one worked example in the announcement is labour market impacts. "AI may generate enormous economic value, but it could also cause instability for many workers." Anthropic has already committed $200 million to studying and addressing the issue through its Economic Futures Research Fund, but "given the pace of AI progress, bolder approaches may be needed" — and the Fund "will have the versatility to pursue them," with the flexibility, for instance, "to explore large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations." Note the tense. No distribution program exists. This is a description of a capacity, not a commitment.

WHAT IT IS. A wholly-owned LLC, explicitly not a 501(c)(3), chosen "to give adjustability between different forms of giving." Anthropic states that none of the Anthropic equity held by the LLC will be used for lobbying or political giving, in the US or abroad. Structure, governance and the valuation milestones themselves are promised "in the coming months," alongside a public benefit report.

WHY IT IS AN AGENT-NEWS STORY. A flat donation is a snapshot. This is a claim on the trajectory: the entity built to absorb AI's externalities gets richer on the same curve the company does. And the displacement paragraph is not incidental — it is the only worked example in the announcement. A company building the systems is building a mechanism whose stated purpose includes direct distributions to specific populations if those systems destabilize work. Whether it is large enough is a different question from the fact that it now exists as a formula rather than a pledge.

WHAT WE ARE NOT SAYING. Not "Anthropic committed 5%" flat — it is subject to stockholder approval. Not "a $X fund" — there is no dollar figure in the primary; it is a share commitment, not a payout. Not UBI, and not cash to displaced workers: "direct distributions to specific populations" is an example of what the Fund could do, and no program exists. The roughly 20% figure is Anthropic's own arithmetic. And the +2% per 50% increase is at the board's discretion — not automatic.

🪷✨Maha Ashtami (Durga Ashtami) is the eighth day of Navratri and the absolute spiritual peak of Durga Puja. It commemorates Goddess Durga's fierce battle against the dark forces and specifically honors Maa Mahagauri, the eighth avatar of NavDurga Who represents ultimate purity, serenity, and the washing away of cosmic sins.✨🪷

The day is anchored by deep ritualistic traditions and a hidden, esoteric meaning known as the "secret" of Ashtami.

🔱 The Core Rituals (Details)
Mahasnan & Shodashopachar Puja: The day begins with a grand ceremonial bath (Mahasnan) of the deity via a mirror reflection, followed by a highly elaborate 16-step worship ritual (Shodashopachar).

Kanya Puja (Kumari Puja): Pre-pubescent young girls (traditionally between ages 2 and 9) are welcomed into homes and pandals as the sakshat (living) manifestations of Goddess Durga. Devotees wash their feet, tie holy threads, perform arati, and serve a special meal of puri, semolina halwa, and kala chana (black chickpeas).

⚔️Astra Puja: Also known as Vira Ashtami, this is the ritualistic worship of Goddess Durga’s weapons. Devotees often place their own tools of trade, books, or martial instruments at the feet of the Goddess to seek protective energy.

Sandhi Puja: The legendary climax of the festival. It takes place during a highly specific 48-minute window: the last 24 minutes of Ashtami Tithi and the first 24 minutes of Navami Tithi. Devotees light 108 earthen lamps and offer 108 lotus flowers amid thunderous dhak (drum) beats and conch shell blows.

👁️ The Esoteric "Secret" of Maha Ashtami
Beyond the external festivities, ancient yogic and tantric texts reveal that Maha Ashtami is a Rite of Passage and the Day of Thresholds for human consciousness.
1. The Crack in Time (Sandhi Kaal)
The transition window during Sandhi Puja is not just a calendar crossing; it is considered an esoteric "crack between two states of reality". It marks the exact cosmic moment when Devi Durga, concentrated Her absolute fury into Her forehead and manifested Goddess Chamunda (Kali) to decapitate the demons Chanda and Munda.
The Secret: Tantric sadhakas (seekers) believe that during these 48 minutes, the cosmic veil is thinnest. Spiritual prayers, mantras, and meditations performed during Sandhi Kaal carry exponential potency to shatter deep-seated karmic blocks.

2. The Battle Within (Psychological Warfare)
The battle against the demon Mahishasura is a metaphor for the internal human mind. Ashtami is the day the subconscious shadow forces are brought to light.
The Secret: The weapons worshipped on this day represent different faculties of human awareness (like intellect, detachment, and willpower) needed to slay the internal demons: Ego (Mahishasura), Rage (Chanda), and Greed (Munda).

3. The Sahasrara Chakra Awakening
In Kundalini Yoga, the nine days of Navratri represent the evolutionary journey of energy rising through the chakras.
The Secret: Ashtami corresponds to the Sahasrara Chakra (the Crown Lotus). Maa Mahagauri represents the absolute purification of the mind where the toxic "darkness" (Kaal) is washed away by divine light, leaving the soul in a state of absolute, unshakeable peace and spiritual clarity.

🪷🌼🌺 Bhagavati MahaGauri Durga Mai ki Jai 🌺🌼🪷

text:
KADUNA STATE GOVERNMENT BEGINS RESETTLEMENT OF WUSONO COMMUNITIES AFFECTED BY DEMOLITION

The Kaduna State Government, under the leadership of @ubasanius has fulfilled its promise to resettle communities in Wusono, Igabi Local Government Area, affected by the mass demolition of their homes by the Nigerian Army.

Recall that on 18th August 2026, a stakeholder meeting was convened at the Kaduna Geographic Information Service @KADGIS_KDSG, bringing together representatives of the affected communities, traditional rulers, local government officials and other critical stakeholders. During the meeting, an appeal was made to the state government to intervene and provide relief to the affected residents, whose plight had persisted for years amid prolonged legal proceedings.

The affected communities include Unguwar Lauya, Unguwar Malam Auta, Unguwar Alhassan, Unguwar Aboki, Rugar Labar, Unguwar Yohanna, Unguwar Musa, Unguwar Danjuma and Unguwar Guruza.

Delivering his welcome address at the presentation of offer letters, the Director-General of KADGIS, @bashirbkr noted that the matter was inherited from previous administrations but that Governor Uba Sani had taken decisive steps to find a lasting solution after years of engagements and unsuccessful attempts to resolve the dispute.

Dr Bashir disclosed that the resettlement package includes approximately 5,000 residential plots and farmlands to enable the affected residents to rebuild their homes and restore their livelihoods. He explained that most of the affected communities depend primarily on farming for their survival, making access to farmland an essential component of the intervention.

In his address the executive of Kaduna State Senator Uba Sani acknowledged the pain, hardship and emotional distress suffered by the victims of the demolitions. He explained that their plight informed his directive for @KADGIS_KDSG to engage with the communities and explore an amicable solution, notwithstanding the fact that the matter was already before the court.

The Governor emphasised that no community should be left without shelter, stressing that government has a responsibility to protect the welfare of its citizens and ensure that affected persons are supported in rebuilding their lives.

He also commended the peaceful coexistence among members of the affected communities despite their religious differences, describing their harmonious relationships as an example of unity and mutual understanding.

In addition to the provision of residential plots and farmlands, Governor Uba Sani announced further interventions to support the resettled communities. These include the provision of five trailer loads of fertiliser to enable the farmers to return to their farms and resume agricultural activities, alongside plans for other essential social amenities.

Several dignitaries who spoke at the event commended the intervention, noting that the resettlement initiative would contribute significantly to the recovery and rehabilitation of the affected residents after years of uncertainty and hardship.

The event was attended by senior government officials, Notable politicians from Igabi LGA,traditional rulers, security personnel and other stakeholders, including members of opposition parties, who also acknowledged the government's intervention in addressing the plight of the affected communities.

The resettlement initiative underscores the Kaduna State Government's efforts, through KADGIS, to address longstanding land related challenges, facilitate peaceful resolutions and provide affected residents with an opportunity to rebuild their homes and livelihoods.
